text:
Tomás Rivera: hey team — Tomás here, joined infra last week. Im on the upcoming rotation but the PagerDuty UI says "not eligible" and my VPN can't reach prod jump host (timeout). Who should I bug for schedule membership + bastion access? :wave:

Kayla M.: welcome Toms! For PD you need to be in the `infra-oncall` Okta group. Submit the oncall-access form: https://wiki.internal/access-requests -> select "oncall eligibility". If you already filed, paste the Okta req id here and I'll chase. For bastion, we do ephemeral keys via github SSH keys + Duo MFA.

Tomás Rivera: filed the form, Okta req OKTA-7321. I tried the PD refresh button but still not eligible. Also I can't SSH to bastion: `ssh -i ~/.ssh/id_rsa bastion@jumphost.redwood.internal` times out.

InfraBot: Okta sync started for user "Tomás Rivera" -> group "infra-oncall" (audit id: 8f2b). Estimated completion: 10m.

Jesse R.: I own the jump hosts. Toms, I can add your pubkey for a 48h window. DM me your github username or paste your public key here (if you prefer public channel, obfuscate). Also confirm Duo is setup on your phone.

Tomás Rivera: I DMed you my github handle (tomasr). Duo is installed and registered. Thanks.

Kayla M.: once Okta group shows you eligible, I can add you to the PD schedule (we run 1-week rotations). Until then you'll be in "backup" on PD and won't receive pages. If you need urgent practice pages, use the PD test flow (instructions below) once you're added.

Anya P.: FYI for onboarding: we expect 2 simulated pages (in #eng-oncall-sim) and 1 live shadow before solo. Readlisted training: /docs/oncall/training.md and the runbook index at /runbooks/index.md. Quick start command to join a sim:```sre-sim start --profile infra --user tomasr```

Tomás Rivera: infraBot just told me Okta sync is pending. Any tips for the sim? I haven't used the incident timeline tool yet.

Jesse R.: tips: 1) follow the triage matrix in incident-lifecycle.md 2) open a timeline entry ASAP with bullets 3) tag the service owner (owner handle in runbook header). For the timeline UI: https://incidents.redwood.com -> New Incident -> select "Playbook exercise".

InfraBot: Okta sync complete: user "Tomás Rivera" added to group "infra-oncall" (audit id: 8f2b).

Kayla M.: added you to PagerDuty schedule (should be live now). Please confirm you receive a test page:
```
# trigger test page via CLI
pd trigger --user "tomas.rivera@redwood.com" --note "oncall eligibility test"
```
If you don't get a notification, ping Jesse and I'll escalate with SSO team.

Tomás Rivera: got the PD push on my phone and email. Also Jesse gave me SSH access to bastion and I can proxy into prod. Thanks everyone.

SRE Training: Scheduled shadow slots: Wed 09:00-11:00 UTC with Kayla, Fri 17:00-19:00 UTC with Anya. Assigned checklist: read runbooks, run PD test, complete 2 sims, attend live shadow. Due: 5 days.

Tomás Rivera: perfect. One last question: what's the policy for making runbook edits? Can I submit PRs for small clarifications during probation?

Jesse R.: yes submit PRs to the runbook repo. For probation we require at least one reviewer from runbook owners + one SRE reviewer. Small typo fixes usually merge fast after owner approval. No direct commits to main.

Tomás Rivera: awesome—thanks for the fast help and the warm welcome. Looking forward to the sims. :rocket:
